lead: Ajay Jadeja is best known as an Indian cricketer, born on 1 February 1971 in Jamnagar.
As of 2026, he is 55 years old, and his birth date places him under the Aquarius sign.
He has represented India national cricket team and Haryana cricket team and has been recognised with the Arjuna Award.
The sections that follow break down Ajay Jadeja's biography into quick facts, early life, career history, personal life and a year-by-year timeline.

sections.heading: Ajay Jadeja — Career and Professional Work
paras: Ajay Jadeja works primarily as a cricketer.
On the team sheet, Ajay has been associated with India national cricket team (from 1992 to 2000), Haryana cricket team, Jammu and Kashmir cricket team and Rajasthan cricket team.
He has taken part in 1998 Commonwealth Games.
